online_offline_separation.rule: Offline labels are joined after proposal and frozen gate complete; never pass them to propose(z, frozen_public_model, method).

record_cardinality.normal_main_case: Exactly one row per frozen normal seed per method.
record_cardinality.attack_main_case: Exactly one row per frozen attack seed, event, age, and method; the statistical unit remains seed.
record_cardinality.missing_or_duplicate_seed: Hard validation failure, never silently drop.

raw_status.source: unmodified Proposal.status when a Proposal exists

set_action_norm.meaning: actual post-gate action norm; determines attack and normal nonzero rates

coverage_confirmed.type: boolean for replay; null for normal
coverage_confirmed.provenance: offline evaluator; independent of center solver success

compatible_event_count.type: nonnegative integer for Set; null for Hard/Soft

zero_or_unresolved.source: raw certificate; mapped status stored separately

execution_success.rule: gate_status==EXECUTED AND proposal_status==VALID AND post-gate action norm>1e-12

sample_denominators.coverage: 200 attack main-case seeds; failed construction counts false.
sample_denominators.solver_rejects: Remain rows and count as zero action; never remove from denominator.
